articles.title: Bitmine buys 28k ETH, completes 97% of treasury accumulation goal
articles.snippet: While Bitmine’s completed 97% of its goal to acquire 5% of Ether’s supply, Tom Lee’s team faces a $5.1 billion unrealized loss on its main treasury asset.

articles.title: New Bitcoin whales spark sell-side risk as unrealized gains hit $9B
articles.snippet: Unrealized gains by whale speculators hit their highest levels on record last week, per data going back to 2016.
